captions.detailed: A compact home-gym workout bench featuring a dark grey metal frame, black cushioned pads, and silver cylindrical accents. The main body consists of a sturdy central support beam set on wide base feet, equipped with transport wheels at the front and a small loop handle. The bench includes a long backrest pad and a shorter seat pad, both mounted on individual horizontal hinge mechanisms, alongside an adjustable ladder-style support bracket below the seat for angle adjustment.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated compact apartment-gym bench with a matte black metal frame, two cushioned pads (a long backrest and a short seat), and a rear ladder support bracket. The bench should feature functional revolute joints for both pads and the support bracket, as well as continuously spinning front transport wheels and a integrated front carry handle.
captions.factory: The code constructs the gym bench by building a base frame assembly with rectangular box sections, a cylindrical front axle, and a loop-shaped handle. It adds two cylindrical transport wheels on a continuous joint. The backrest pad and seat pad are modeled as chamfered or rounded boxes and attached via revolute joints on horizontal cylindrical pins. Finally, a ladder-style support bracket is built using parallel side rails and cylindrical rungs, connected to the lower frame via a revolute joint.
